name: CanvaDesignAI Design Constitution
description: Canonical design standards that every design generated by CanvaDesignAI must obey. Loaded by the Generator agent as system instructions and by the Reviewer agent as the scoring rubric.

contrast.rule: Body text must maintain at least a 4.5:1 luminance contrast ratio against its background; headline/large text (>=24px bold or >=18.66px) must maintain at least 3:1.

forbidden_combinations.reason: Simultaneous contrast vibration; unreadable for red-green color-blind users (~8% of men); clashes rather than complements.
Near-zero luminance contrast; text disappears at a glance.
Both mid-luminance, high-chroma colors fight for attention and vibrate optically when adjacent.
Insufficient luminance separation even though hues differ; fails contrast ratio despite looking 'different' to the designer.

harmony_rules: Prefer a 60-30-10 distribution: 60% dominant/neutral, 30% secondary, 10% accent.
Use complementary pairs (opposite on the color wheel) only for small accents, never for large adjacent fields of equal size.
Analogous palettes (3 hues within 60deg of each other) are the safe default for backgrounds and large surfaces.
Every palette must include one near-neutral (off-white, cream, charcoal, or muted gray) to give the eye rest space.

palette_size.rule: Exactly one dominant, one supporting, and one accent color at minimum; up to two additional neutrals/tints allowed.

approved_pairings.name: Modern Bold / Editorial Serif
approved_pairings.headline: Montserrat (Bold/ExtraBold)
approved_pairings.use_case: Cafes, boutiques, lifestyle brands wanting a premium-but-approachable feel.

approved_pairings.name: Friendly Rounded
approved_pairings.headline: Baloo 2 (Bold)
approved_pairings.use_case: Kids brands, community events, casual food & beverage.

approved_pairings.name: Tech / Startup
approved_pairings.headline: Space Grotesk (Bold)
approved_pairings.use_case: Product launches, tech events, app promos.

hierarchy.rule: Headline font size must be at least 1.8x the body text size to establish clear visual hierarchy.

rules: Never pair two decorative/display fonts together.
Never pair two serif fonts or two script fonts together in the same design.
Body text must always be a highly legible Sans-Serif or Serif at regular weight; scripts and decorative fonts are reserved for short headlines only (<=6 words).

white_space.rule: Minimum gap between any text block and adjacent image/graphic element must be >= 6% of the canvas's shortest dimension. Outer margins (canvas edge to nearest element) must be >= 5% of the canvas's shortest dimension. Padding inside a text block (between text and its bounding box/card edge) must be >= 4%.
white_space.density_guideline: No more than ~35% of total canvas area should be occupied by text; the remainder is reserved for visual breathing room and imagery.

layout.safe_zones: Keep all critical text and logos within the inner 90% of the canvas (5% bleed/margin on every side).
layout.composition_rule: Rule of thirds: place primary focal point (product, face, or headline) on or near a third-line intersection.
layout.text_to_visual_split: Default split is 40% text zone / 60% visual zone unless the concept explicitly calls for a different ratio; never let text and primary visual overlap without a scrim or contrast-safe backdrop.

criteria.question: Does the color palette respect the contrast and forbidden-combination rules above?
Is the headline/body text readable at a glance (size, hierarchy, font pairing)?
Does the layout leave sufficient negative space between text and imagery?
Is this reusable as a Canva Creator template (clear placeholders, draggable frame, sensible layout instructions)?
Do the palette, typography, and image prompt feel like one coherent theme?

review_rubric.scale: 0-10 per criterion, weighted average determines final score.
